description: Discover relevant Reddit discussions with Google Search and read up to three thread pages through Gemini URL context. Returns Gemini-read titles, authors, post excerpts, relative ages, available scores/comment counts and sampled human comments, plus cited model summaries. Check coverage and warnings: pages may be cached, extraction is not independently verified, and exact dates, growth and quote-based insights are unavailable. risingThreads is a deprecated alias of relevantThreads. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.
